blends.name: Portrait of Carlos Cortés
blends.desc:
Wow, is it refreshing to meet a kindred spirit doing what they so obviously love to do! That is exactly how I met an incredible writer, performer, father, and professor named Carlos E. Cortés. My wife and I had the privilege to see his one-person autobiographical play, "A Conversation with Alana," as he performed it brilliantly at the Riverside Public Library as part of their 2022 Cinco de Mayo celebration in Southern California. 

It was on this inspiring occasion that I drew this portrait of Carlos Cortés and thereafter, wrote an article about the experience at https://peakd.com/art/@joechiappetta/portrait-of-carlos-cortes-and-us-all

The ingredient NFTs to aquire this very rare NFT can initially only be found in select [ArtVndngMchn Series 3](https://neftyblocks.com/c/artvndngmchn/drops/101389) fine art packs.

blends.name: Holy Wheels
blends.desc:
**Holy Wheels**
By Joe Chiappetta

Not everyone is going to believe that Jesus rose from the dead, leaving behind an empty tomb. I know that because I spent my first 30 years mostly either oblivious to the resurrection, indifferent to it, doubting it, or even denying it. Yet now I completely believe, trust, and rely on what the resurrection means. For myself and many others, that has directly led to a resurrected life of our own. Join with us, and most importantly, with Jesus, on the "Holy Wheels" ride of a lifetime. 

You can see more of the big picture about the resurrection and related topics in my illustrated book, *Bible Math*. It can be read for free online at https://joechiappetta.blogspot.com/p/bible-math.html

---
The essential ingredients to acquire this extremely rare digital art can initially be found only in select [ArtVndngMchn Series 3](https://neftyblocks.com/c/artvndngmchn/drops/101389) fine art NFT packs.

Collecting, in one form or another, is an engaging activity for so many people. Like stamps, coins, comics, books, records, action figures, stickers, shoes, hats, and toy cars, the making of many NFTs has no end. So enjoy the ones you have.

blends.name: Metanoia Man
blends.desc:
**Metanoia Man**
A legendary rare digital art edition of only 9 by Joe Chiappetta
One of the essential ingredients to acquire this blend can be found in random [ArtVndngMchn Series 3](https://neftyblocks.com/c/artvndngmchn/drops/101389) fine art NFT packs.

In all its volcanic drama, Metanoia Man just might be a self-portrait of us all. The word "metanoia" comes from the Greek, meaning to change one's mind, to repent. When we are not very self-disciplined in our minds, our own internal thoughts can too often become highly volatile and even toxic. Gratefully Jesus shows the way--and is the way--to change our minds... for the better. 

You can read more about metanoia, as an essential component of life in my book, *Bible Math*, which can be read for free online at https://joechiappetta.blogspot.com/p/bible-math.html

blends.name: Metaverse Art Manifesto
blends.desc:
Art by Joe Chiappetta and Kara Mia

In all circumstances, there is no time to be mediocre. There's no time to waste. As an artistic reminder of these essential life principles, a metaverse art manifesto is in order. 
**Give the art you want to inspire.
Exhibit the art you want to interact with.
Make the art you want to collect.
Respect the artist over the art.
Serve the God who made the artist.**

blends.name: Potato Harbor at Santa Cruz Island, California
blends.desc:
Artwork by Joe Chiappetta
Rarity: Legendary (edition of only 5)

My son, Luke, and I took an incredible 5-hour kayaking trip along Santa Cruz Island, off of Ventura, California. We paddled through some of the largest accessible ocean caves in the world as part of an unforgettable adventure. This drawing of Potato Harbor was my only drawing of the day, during a much-needed lunch break. The rest of the trip is all committed to muscle memory. I am very grateful for my son, who booked the trip and probably rowed just a bit more than I did in our 2-person kayak.

Most essential ingredients needed to acquire this NFT can randomly be found in [ArtVndngMchn Series 2 Packs](https://wax.atomichub.io/drops/artvndngmchn) (both the Standard and/or Master packs).

by Joe Chiappetta and Mitzi Azalea

Playing with dirt has been a recurring fun thing to do throughout my life. This ArtVndngMchn collaboration with the talented photographer, Mitzi Azalea, is no exception. Mitzi started by shooting a fine art photo depicting the dirt of the earth, and I finished by painting a fine art cube of Minecraft dirt. Since both of us build and operate interactive 3D galleries in the Minecraft metaverse known as The Uplift World, this makes very down-to-earth sense. You can see Mitzi's original photo (called *Earth.1*) before I painted on it for our sanctioned collaboration here: https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/template/mitzisniftis/329499
